newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden to sell 34 pct Stadshypotek stake.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to sell 34 pct Stadshypotek stake.

text.p: The Swedish government will sell the state's 34 percent stake in mortgage lender Stadshypotek AB, the Ministry of Finance announced.
The stake will be sold to an industrial buyer through a controlled auction, Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said in a statement.

Asbrink said on Thursday in a parliamentary budget debate that the government would seek the highest possible price for Stadshypotek, Sweden's largest mortgage lender, but it would also consider the agency's competitive situation and its staff.

The ministry said parliament on Friday adopted legislation requiring the Urban Mortgage Bank to transfer its shares in Stadshypotek to the Swedish state. The legislation also allowed the government then to sell those shares at the highest possible price.
The stake to be sold comprises 9,000,706 A shares and 32,500,000 B shares which together make up 34 percent of Stadshypotek's capital and voting rights.
Asbrink said in the statement: "The government has decided to focus on selling its shares to an industrial buyer through a controlled auction process."

Potential buyers will have the opportunity to bid for all of the state's shares. "A handful of industrial buyers in Sweden and internationally have already contacted the ministry to indicate their preliminary interest," Asbrink said.
